body.text:
An integrator found that airlift can check and update apps but can't roll them back. This adds `airlift rollback <name>`.

- **Previous version**: switching to a new tree writes the replaced lockfile entry to `apps/<name>/previous.json`. It's kept outside the lockfile, so releases that predate rollback can still read the lockfile. Rollback activates it the way an install does, with the same command checks and airlift's `--version` check. Rolling back again rolls forward.
- **Hold**: rolling back to an older version leaves `apps/<name>/held`. `airlift update` without a name skips a held app, and `check --json` reports `"held": true` so apps that check for their own updates can stay quiet. Updating the app by name lifts the hold.
- **Layout version**: the lockfile now has `"layout": 1`, and an airlift refuses a newer layout than it reads. airlift 0.1.8 can't read layout 1, so rollback won't move airlift below `Lockfile.FirstAirlift` (0.1.9), which assumes this ships in the next release.

docs/design.md has a new Rollback section and documents the layout version and `held`.

title.text: Add airlift rollback, and a layout version for the root
